title: Kiln inference API contract v1
description: Canonical field-level wire contract for POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/completions, and POST /v1/completions/batch. Request objects explicitly identify Kiln's OpenAI-compatibility policy for unknown inputs; response objects describe only fields Kiln emits. Arbitrary JSON remains deliberate only for OpenAI tool definitions, tool choices, calls, and chat-template extension values.

AdapterRef.description: One saved adapter and its composition scale.

name.description: Saved adapter name. The runtime also rejects path separators, traversal, and absolute paths.

scale.description: Composition scale used when merging request-wide adapters. The request must contain a finite JSON number; Kiln applies no narrower range.

BatchCompletionItem.description: One generated choice from one prompt in a batch request.

completion_index.description: Zero-based choice index for this prompt.

text.description: Final answer content after separated reasoning.

reasoning_content.description: Reasoning text inside the model's thinking block; omitted when absent.

tool_calls.description: OpenAI-shaped tool calls; omitted when absent.

thinking_budget.description: Completion-specific terminal thinking-budget outcome; omitted when no budget applied.

BatchCompletionMetadata.description: Request-wide metadata for a completed batch response.

BatchCompletionRequest.description: Generate one or more choices for each conversation in a batch.

model.description: Served model ID. Missing or null selects the configured served_model_id.

prompts.description: One message array per prompt. prompts.length multiplied by n must not exceed 64 outputs.

n.description: Completions per prompt. Missing or null means 1.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling probability mass. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

top_k.description: Maximum candidate count for top-k filtering. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

min_p.description: Minimum probability relative to the most likely token. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

presence_penalty.description: OpenAI-style presence penalty. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

frequency_penalty.description: OpenAI-style frequency penalty. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

repetition_penalty.description: Token repetition penalty. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

sampling_preset.description: Named group of sampling defaults; explicit sampling fields take precedence.

max_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per completion. Null uses the runtime default.

max_completion_tokens.description: Newer OpenAI alias. max_tokens wins when both are non-null.

ignore_eos.description: Treat tokenizer EOS IDs as ordinary tokens; max_tokens and explicit stop sequences still bound generation.

thinking_budget_tokens.description: Per-request thinking-token limit override; null explicitly removes the limit.

thinking_budget_ms.description: Per-request thinking-time limit in milliseconds; null explicitly removes the limit.

stop.description: One or more decoded-text stop sequences.

seed.description: Request seed; null lets the runtime choose.

adapter.description: One adapter applied to every prompt. Mutually exclusive with adapters.

adapters.description: Request-wide adapter composition. Mutually exclusive with adapter.

tools.description: Request-wide OpenAI-shaped tool definitions forwarded to the chat template.

tool_choice.description: Opaque OpenAI tool_choice value forwarded to the chat template.

chat_template_kwargs.description: Request-wide keyword arguments forwarded to the chat template.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: the effective max_tokens must fit the active tokenizer's reasoning close sequence when a thinking budget applies

BatchCompletionResponse.description: All choices, token usage, and request-wide metadata from a batch generation request.

object.description: OpenAI-style object discriminator for a batch completion.

model.description: Served model ID used for every completion.

completions.description: Generated choices in prompt order, then completion order.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One OpenAI-compatible server-sent event in a streaming chat completion.

id.description: Chat-completion identifier shared by every chunk in the stream.

model.description: Served model ID used for this completion.

choices.description: Incremental choices carried by this chunk; the usage-only chunk has none.

usage.description: Token counts for this individual completion.

ChatCompletionChunkStream.description: Server-sent event stream containing JSON `ChatCompletionChunk` events, optional `kiln.token_timing` events when `include_performance` is true, an optional usage chunk with no choices when `stream_options.include_usage` is true, and a final `data: [DONE]` sentinel. The terminal finish chunk carries thinking-budget metadata before the optional usage chunk and sentinel.

ChatCompletionMetadata.description: Kiln-specific thinking, configuration, and performance metadata for a chat completion.

thinking_enabled.description: Whether the rendered prompt enabled model thinking.

thinking_mode.description: Mode observed from the rendered prompt.

thinking_source.description: Authority that selected the effective thinking mode.

default_thinking_enabled.description: Configured server or template default before a request override.

final_content_empty.description: Whether the final answer content is empty after reasoning separation.

content_empty_reason.description: Reason final answer content is empty; omitted when content is present.

reasoning_folded_into_content.description: Whether compatibility mode copied separated reasoning into content.

config_hashes.description: Configuration hashes when requested or enabled by default.

performance.description: Request-local performance metadata when requested or enabled by default.

ChatCompletionPerformanceMetadata.description: Token counts and request-local latency measurements emitted when performance metadata is enabled.

ttft_ms.description: Time to first generated token in milliseconds, or null when unavailable.

prefill_ms.description: Measured prompt-prefill work in milliseconds, or null when unavailable.

actor_queue_ms.description: Time waiting in the batching actor's queue, or null off the actor path.

actor_admission_ms.description: Time from actor receipt to workload admission, or null off the actor path.

actor_prefill_wall_ms.description: Wall-clock time from actor admission through prompt prefill, or null off the actor path.

resident_prefill_used.description: Whether prefill used resident recurrent state, or null when the route does not report it.

decode_ms.description: Measured token-decode work in milliseconds, or null when unavailable.

total_latency_ms.description: Request latency from handler entry through response construction, in milliseconds.

decode_tokens_per_sec.description: Generated tokens divided by measured decode time, or null when unavailable.

adapter_used.description: Base or named adapter selection used for generation.

thinking_mode.description: Thinking mode observed from the rendered prompt.

latency.description: Detailed latency diagnostics when the serving path recorded them; otherwise null.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: Create one or more OpenAI-compatible chat-completion choices.

model.description: Served model ID. Missing or null selects the configured served_model_id.

n.description: Number of choices. Values above 1 require stream=false.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling probability mass. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

top_k.description: Maximum candidate count for top-k filtering. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

min_p.description: Minimum probability relative to the most likely token. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

presence_penalty.description: OpenAI-style presence penalty. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

frequency_penalty.description: OpenAI-style frequency penalty. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

repetition_penalty.description: Token repetition penalty. Null uses the selected preset or runtime default.

sampling_preset.description: Named group of sampling defaults; explicit sampling fields take precedence.

max_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per choice. Null uses the runtime default.

max_completion_tokens.description: Newer OpenAI alias. max_tokens wins when both are non-null.

ignore_eos.description: Treat tokenizer EOS IDs as ordinary tokens; incompatible with rollout_provenance=true.

thinking_budget_tokens.description: Per-request thinking-token limit override; null explicitly removes the limit.

thinking_budget_ms.description: Per-request thinking-time limit in milliseconds; null explicitly removes the limit.

stream.description: Return server-sent events instead of one JSON response.

stream_options.description: Additional streaming behavior; ignored for a non-streaming request.

stop.description: One or more decoded-text stop sequences.

seed.description: Request seed; null lets the runtime choose.

adapter.description: Missing uses the server default; null or an empty string selects base; a non-empty string selects a named adapter. Mutually exclusive with adapters.

adapters.description: Per-request adapter composition. Mutually exclusive with adapter.

tools.description: OpenAI-shaped tool definitions forwarded to the chat template.

tool_choice.description: Opaque OpenAI tool_choice value forwarded to the chat template.

chat_template_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments forwarded to the chat template.

fold_reasoning_into_content.description: Override whether separated reasoning is also copied into final content.

include_performance.description: Override whether the response includes request-local performance metadata.

include_config_hashes.description: Override whether the response includes content hashes for the active configuration.

rollout_provenance.description: Emit exact behavior-policy provenance. Requires one non-streaming real batched choice, ignore_eos=false, no non-empty tools or tool_choice, and positive effective generation capacity.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: rollout_provenance=true requires the real batching engine and content-addressed base-policy identity
rollout_provenance=true rejects non-empty tools and non-null tool_choice
the effective max_tokens must fit the active tokenizer's reasoning close sequence when a thinking budget applies

ChatCompletionResponse.description: A non-streaming OpenAI-compatible chat completion with Kiln metadata.

model.description: Served model ID used for generation.

ChatMessageInput.description: One input message passed to the model's chat template.

role.description: Template-visible role. Kiln forwards the string rather than enforcing a fixed vocabulary.

content.description: String, null, or OpenAI content-part array. Text/input_text/output_text parts are concatenated and non-text parts are ignored.

reasoning_content.description: Prior assistant reasoning preserved for template round trips.

tool_calls.description: Prior assistant tool calls preserved for the next template render.

tool_call_id.description: Tool-call identifier associated with a tool response.

ChatMessageOutput.description: One assistant message emitted in a non-streaming choice.

content.description: Final answer content after reasoning separation.

reasoning_content.description: Separated reasoning content; omitted when absent.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls emitted by the assistant; omitted when absent.

tool_call_id.description: Tool-call identifier associated with a tool response.

message.description: Complete assistant message for this choice.

finish_reason.description: Why generation ended for this choice.

ChunkChoice.description: One incremental choice in a streaming chat chunk.

delta.description: Fields added by this streaming chunk.

finish_reason.description: Why generation ended; present only on the terminal chunk.

ConfigHashes.description: Content hashes that identify the tokenizer, templates, model configuration, and resolved inference configuration.

chat_template_hash.description: Hash of the inference chat template.

training_chat_template_hash.description: Hash of the training chat template.

effective_config_hash.description: Hash of the resolved inference configuration.

Delta.description: Incremental message fields emitted in a streaming choice.

role.description: Role emitted when a streaming choice begins.

tool_calls.description: Tool-call deltas emitted by this chunk.

FinishReason.description: Why generation ended. `error` identifies a per-item batch failure; ordinary termination emits `stop`, `length`, or `tool_calls`.

actor_queue_ms.description: Time waiting for the batching actor to receive the request.

actor_admission_ms.description: Time between actor receipt and workload admission.

tokenization_ms.description: Time spent rendering and tokenizing the prompt.

prefill_ms.description: Measured accelerator time spent processing prompt tokens.

decode_ms.description: Measured accelerator time spent generating tokens.

sampling_ms.description: Time spent selecting output tokens from logits.

readback_ms.description: Time spent transferring inference results to the host.

response_delivery_ms.description: Time from token readiness to producer handoff.

handler_queue_ms.description: Time from producer handoff to HTTP-handler receipt.

client_delivery_ms.description: Time from handler receipt to response-body enqueue.

gpu_lock_wait_ms.description: Time waiting for exclusive accelerator ownership.

graph_capture_ms.description: Time spent capturing an accelerator graph.

graph_replay_ms.description: Time spent submitting an accelerator graph replay.

synchronization_ms.description: Time spent waiting for accelerator synchronization.

trim_ms.description: Time spent trimming or reclaiming runtime-owned storage.

adapter_ms.description: Time spent loading, composing, or applying an adapter.

training_ms.description: Time blocked by accelerator work owned by training.

unexplained_ms.description: Measured latency not covered by another reported phase.

LatencyPhaseTimings.description: Bounded request phase timings; null means the serving path did not measure that subphase.

LatencyStallReasonCounts.description: Number of retained inter-token stalls attributed to each bounded phase.

actor_queue.description: Stalls primarily attributed to batching-actor queueing.

actor_admission.description: Stalls primarily attributed to batching-actor admission.

actor_prefill.description: Stalls primarily attributed to another request's actor-owned prefill.

actor_decode.description: Stalls primarily attributed to actor-owned decode work.

actor_cycle_idle.description: Stalls primarily attributed to intentional actor pacing.

response_delivery.description: Stalls primarily attributed to producer handoff.

handler_queue.description: Stalls primarily attributed to the queue before the HTTP handler.

client_delivery.description: Stalls primarily attributed to response-body delivery.

sampling.description: Stalls primarily attributed to token sampling.

readback.description: Stalls primarily attributed to accelerator readback.

gpu_lock_wait.description: Stalls primarily attributed to accelerator-ownership waits.

graph_capture.description: Stalls primarily attributed to graph capture.

graph_replay.description: Stalls primarily attributed to graph replay.

synchronization.description: Stalls primarily attributed to accelerator synchronization.

resize.description: Stalls primarily attributed to storage resizing.

trim.description: Stalls primarily attributed to storage trimming or reclaim.

adapter.description: Stalls primarily attributed to adapter work.

training.description: Stalls primarily attributed to training-owned accelerator work.

unexplained.description: Stalls that no measured phase explains.

NonNegativeInteger.description: An integer greater than or equal to zero.

NullableNonNegativeNumber.description: A non-negative finite JSON number or null.

NullableSamplingNumber.description: Finite JSON number or null. The chat and batch endpoints currently apply no narrower range check before sampling.

oneOf.description: Opaque OpenAI tool definitions forwarded to the chat template.

PromptLogprobEntry.description: The log probability, rank, and decoded text for one candidate token.

logprob.description: Natural-log probability assigned to this token.

rank.description: One-based vocabulary rank by log probability.

decoded_token.description: Tokenizer-decoded text for this token ID.

PromptLogprobMap.description: Map from decimal token ID strings to the observed/top-K log-probability entry.

emitted_tokens.description: Number of generated tokens emitted by the request.

retained_gap_samples.description: Inter-token gaps retained for percentile calculation after the bounded sample cap.

gap_samples_truncated.description: Whether the request produced more gap samples than the diagnostic retained.

ttft_ms.description: Time from request start to the first generated token.

stall_threshold_ms.description: Inter-token gap at or above which a sample is classified as a stall.

stall_count.description: Number of inter-token gaps classified as stalls.

unexplained_stall_count.description: Number of stalls not covered by a measured phase.

stall_reasons.description: Stall counts grouped by the phase with the largest overlap.

phases.description: Measured request time grouped by bounded phase.

RequestLatencyDiagnostics.description: Request-local TTFT, ITL tail, bounded stall reasons, and honest phase-coverage diagnostics.

RolloutActionTokenV1.description: One generated token labeled as sampled or forced, with the behavior-policy log probability present only for sampled tokens.

RolloutAdapterIdentityV1.description: The name and content hash of the adapter used for a rollout.

content_sha256.description: Content hash of the adapter used for generation.

RolloutBehaviorPolicyIdentityV1.description: Content-addressed identity of the model, adapter, configuration, and implementation that generated a rollout.

served_model_id.description: Model ID exposed by the inference API.

base_model_sha256.description: Canonical content hash of the base model.

adapter.description: Adapter identity when generation used one; omitted for base.

inference_config_sha256.description: Hash of the resolved inference policy.

implementation.description: Implementation identity that generated the rollout.

RolloutChatTemplateInvocationV1.description: Tool and template inputs that affected the rendered rollout prompt.

tools.description: Tool definitions supplied to the chat template.

tool_choice.description: OpenAI-shaped tool-choice value supplied to the chat template.

template_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments supplied to the chat template.

RolloutIdentityText.description: Non-empty, trimmed identity text without control characters. The schema's `maxLength` bounds code points; the runtime also rejects surrounding whitespace and enforces at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

RolloutProvenanceV1.description: Exact prompt, action-token, behavior-policy, tokenizer, sampling, and backend evidence for one generated rollout.

input_token_ids.description: Rendered prompt tokens followed by every generated action token.

prompt_token_count.description: Number of leading input_token_ids that belong to the rendered prompt.

prompt_messages_sha256.description: Hash of the canonical input-message payload.

scored_payload_sha256.description: Hash of the exact token payload scored by the behavior policy.

action_tokens.description: Ordered generated tokens with sampled-versus-forced provenance.

behavior_policy.description: Content-addressed policy that generated the action tokens.

tokenizer.description: Content-addressed tokenizer used for prompt rendering and generation.

template_invocation.description: Tool and template arguments that affected prompt rendering; omitted when empty.

sampling.description: Resolved sampling configuration used for generation.

generation_backend.description: Backend name that generated the rollout.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: action token sequence_index values are strictly increasing and index generated tokens
at least one action token is sampled
forced action token IDs belong to sampling.thinking_budget.close_token_ids

RolloutSamplingConfigV1.description: Resolved sampling policy used to generate a rollout.

top_k.description: Resolved maximum candidate count; zero disables top-k filtering.

min_p.description: Resolved minimum probability relative to the most likely token.

thinking_budget.description: Resolved thinking limit when one applied.

RolloutThinkingBudgetV1.description: Resolved thinking limit and the token sequence used to close the thinking block.

max_tokens.description: Maximum thinking tokens before forced closure.

max_time_ms.description: Maximum thinking time in milliseconds before forced closure.

close_token_ids.description: Token sequence forced when a thinking limit closes the thinking block.

RolloutTokenizerIdentityV1.description: Content hashes for the tokenizer vocabulary, configuration, and chat template.

chat_template_sha256.description: Hash of the chat template used to render the rollout prompt.

SamplingPreset.description: Named sampling profile. Known values are `qwen3-thinking-general`, `qwen3-thinking-coding`, `qwen3-non-thinking-general`, `qwen3-non-thinking-reasoning`, and `greedy`. For compatibility, the current runtime maps an unknown string to `qwen3-thinking-general` instead of rejecting it.

Sha256.description: A lowercase SHA-256 digest prefixed with sha256:.

StopInput.description: Missing or null means no explicit stop sequence. One string and an array of strings normalize to the same internal list.

StreamOptions.description: Options that control additional events in a streaming response.

include_usage.description: Emit a final empty-choices chunk containing usage before [DONE].

StreamingTerminalMetadata.description: Metadata attached only to the terminal finish chunk.

StreamingTokenTiming.description: Request-relative timestamps and blocking attribution for one streamed token.

source.description: Producer path that owns ready and delivery timestamps.

token_id.description: Accepted model token represented by this timing event, including a special token that decodes to no visible text.

ready_ms.description: Time when model work produced the token, relative to request start.

producer_delivered_ms.description: Time when the generation producer handed off the token.

handler_received_ms.description: Time when the HTTP handler received the token.

body_enqueued_ms.description: Time when the handler enqueued the token event for the response body.

response_delivery_ms.description: Delay from token readiness to producer handoff.

handler_queue_ms.description: Delay from producer handoff to HTTP-handler receipt.

queue_delay_ms.description: Compatibility aggregate equal to response_delivery_ms + handler_queue_ms.

client_delivery_ms.description: Delay from handler receipt to response-body enqueue.

blocking_phase.description: Phase attributed as the dominant blocking interval for this token, or null.

TextCompletionChoice.description: Prompt log probabilities and termination status for one scored prompt.

index.description: Zero-based choice index; always zero for this endpoint.

text.description: Generated text; empty in prompt-logprob scoring mode.

prompt_logprobs.description: One entry per prompt token. The first is null; later maps contain the observed token plus requested top-K candidates.

TextCompletionRequest.description: Score prompt-token log probabilities through the compatibility completions endpoint.

model.description: Must match the served base model when non-null.

prompt.description: Text or raw token IDs. The tokenized prompt is capped at 4096 and the served context length.

max_tokens.description: Must be null, 0, or 1. This endpoint scores prompt log probabilities; it does not provide general text generation.

prompt_logprobs.description: Requested top K. The runtime also caps K by vocabulary size and total returned candidates at 65536.

n.description: Compatibility field. Missing, null, and 1 all request the single supported choice.

add_special_tokens.description: Tokenizer special-token insertion for text prompts; ignored for token-ID prompts.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: the tokenized prompt is non-empty and has at most min(4096, served context length) tokens
raw token IDs and prompt_logprobs do not exceed the served vocabulary
real scoring rejects an active LoRA until adapter revision identity can be pinned

TextCompletionResponse.description: Prompt-token log probabilities, identity, and token usage for one scored prompt.

model.description: Served base-model ID used for scoring.

system_fingerprint.description: Canonical content-addressed teacher identity; mock responses retain the field as null.

ThinkingBudgetConfigurationMetadata.description: Request-wide resolved thinking limits and their configuration sources.

configured.description: Whether either resolved thinking limit is finite.

max_tokens.description: Resolved thinking-token limit; omitted when unlimited.

max_time_ms.description: Resolved thinking-time limit in milliseconds; omitted when unlimited.

tokens_source.description: Authority that supplied or removed the thinking-token limit.

time_source.description: Authority that supplied or removed the thinking-time limit.

ToolCallArray.description: Opaque OpenAI-shaped tool-call values. Kiln normalizes generated Qwen tool calls but preserves prior-turn values for template round trips.

UnixSeconds.description: Whole seconds since the Unix epoch.

Usage.description: Prompt, completion, and total token counts.
